bio: Shop and bistro Champagne + Fromage brings rustic fare and award winning fizz to London, served the French way.  Indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea featuring a delicately arranged tower of traditional finger sandwiches, homemade raspberry macaroons, lemon polenta tart and homemade croissants with jam and butter alongside a flute of one of the Grower Champagnes. The Fromagerie offers more than 50 French soft and hard cheeses, from Brie, Comte or Tome to a range of Blues and Camembert. In addition to a wide range of cooked meat, pâtés, ham and saucisson, shelves are piled high with jars of terrine, rillettes, cassoulets or delicious confits, all sourced from authentic French suppliers. Set just a stones throw away from the river, Greenwich station is just a few minutes walk away.
